messages:
Nina (PM): Quick design sync. We need a concrete retention matrix + export format decision for enterprise compliance. Key asks: per-event retention by class (auth, admin, inference, alerts), self-service retention UI, export format (NDJSON vs Parquet), and a clear BYOK onboarding checklist. Can we decide MVP scope today?

Ethan (Eng): High-level proposal:
- Data classes & defaults: auth=365d, admin=7y (for legal), inference.logs=180d, alerts=90d
- UI: per-tenant toggles with presets (eDiscovery, SOC2, Minimal)
- Exports: NDJSON for immediate human readability + Parquet as compressed enterprise option
- BYOK Phase 1: KMS integration (AWS/GCP Azure), proof-of-possession via signed CSR, and key usage logging

Riya (Security): For exports, we should standardize on NDJSON with a signed manifest (SHA256) for MVP. Parquet is fine for bulk ops later but increases schema mapping work. Export manifest must include: request_id, tenant_id, time-range, event-count, sha256 list, signer identity.

Carlos (Legal): Signed manifest + retention matrix look good. Need to ensure export SLA in contracts. Also confirm we can provide admin=7y by default without creating additional legal exposure. Might need opt-in for that long retention in some regions.

Ola (Customer Success): Customers want templates for auditors. Please include a sample NDJSON schema and an example manifest. Many auditors accept NDJSON; Parquet may slow down audit review.

Ben (Sales): Upsell angle: offer Parquet + expedited exports as a premium. BYOK onboarding package with runbook & concierge.

Ethan (Eng): Implementation notes:
- Storage: separate buckets per-tenant + object prefixes per data class
- Enforce retention via object-lock/retention metadata where supported; fallback to managed TTL jobs on platforms without object-lock
- Export jobs: job-per-request, chunk to 100k events, create manifest, sign with platform key for MVP; BYOK tenants can opt to sign with their KMS public key (verify signature on receipt)

Riya (Security): Security acceptance criteria (MVP):
1) Exports contain signed manifest with per-object checksums
2) Retention rules are enforceable (either object-lock or immutable-flag + retention-worker)
3) BYOK tenants have auditable key usage logs (key id, operation, timestamp)

Ethan (Eng): Edge cases: cross-region retention rules (EU data must stay in EU), pseudonymized inference logs (for privacy) vs raw logs for compliance — need mapping. Also large tenants may request on-demand longer retention for narrow event sets.

Nina (PM): Proposed MVP scope (Q2):
- Retention matrix UI with presets + per-class overrides (self-serve for paid tiers)
- NDJSON export with signed manifest (72h standard SLA)
- Basic BYOK onboarding docs + KMS integration for verify-signing (no escrow)
- Storage enforcement: S3-compatible object-lock + TTL worker fallback

Carlos (Legal): 72h SLA acceptable baseline. We'll add an expedited 24h clause for enterprise with pricing and liability caps. I'll draft language.

Ola (Customer Success): Also need: onboarding checklist for BYOK with sample IAM roles/policies, pre-check script, and a two-week concierge option for first 5 customers.

Ben (Sales): We'll map pricing tiers: standard exports included, expedited + Parquet + concierge as add-ons. Good for GTM.

Ethan (Eng): Rollout plan:
- Week 1: schema + retention matrix spec + NDJSON example (engineering)
- Week 2: storage enforcement + export worker prototype
- Week 3: manifest signing + verify flows + BYOK verify mode
- Week 4: UI + docs + limited beta with 3 pilot customers

Riya (Security): QA checklist items: manifest verification, tamper-evidence tests, key rotation test, cross-region enforcement test.

Nina (PM): Decision asks for leadership: 1) Approve NDJSON-first export (Parquet later)? 2) Approve retention defaults draft? 3) Approve BYOK Phase 1 (verify-signing, no escrow) and concierge onboarding as paid add-on?

Carlos (Legal): Approve NDJSON-first. Approve retention defaults subject to region opt-in. BYOK Phase 1 OK without escrow; escrow opt-in can be discussed later.

Ben (Sales): Approve product + pricing direction. We'll line up pilot customers.

Ethan (Eng): Technical blockers: object-lock differences across cloud providers, signature verification support for customer-managed keys (we need to validate KMS public key format). I'll produce compatibility doc.

Nina (PM): Action items: @Ethan - retention schema + NDJSON example (due Tue). @Riya - security tests checklist (due Wed). @Carlos - contract clauses for SLA/regions (due Thu). @Ola/Ben - pilot customer shortlist & onboarding plan (due Fri). I'll draft PRD once items are in. Infra-bot: note quotas will apply for exports >500GB.

infra-bot: Quota alert rule saved: exports >500GB require approval from infra oncall.
